page.overview:
Who is Fred?

Fred is one of the few named security guards employed by Willard Whyte's Techtronics Plant in California, who appeared the 1971 James Bond film Diamonds Are Forever. The character's actor remains unknown.

When James Bond attempts to escape in the experimental moon buggy, he is pursued by a team of guards, including Fred, who end up crashing their vehicles during the chase. Watching Bond drive off into the distance, one of Fred's fellow guards asks him to call the sheriff's office.
